args.name: AgentRuntimeSchemaSql
args.summary: SQLite DDL for graph agent runtime tables (7 tables)
args.whenToUse: Need persistence DDL for agent runs/checkpoints/tools/hitl
args.howToUse: Apply docs/schema/generated/agent-runtime-migration.sql via better-sqlite3 or migrate runner

args.name: RunStatus
args.description: Agent run lifecycle status: created | running | waiting_hitl | completed | failed | cancelled.

args.name: SchedulerResult
args.description: Result of a scheduled graph run: final status, channels, node history, error, output, and HITL interrupt when waiting_hitl.

args.name: CompiledGraph
args.description: Immutable compile output consumed by the scheduler: validated graph with precomputed adjacency, terminals, and entry node.

args.name: GraphDefinition
args.description: Authoring-time graph definition: nodes, edges, optional graphId/entryNodeId. Input to compileGraph.

args.name: HitlDecision
args.description: Human decision payload for HITL resume: action string, optional data, decidedAt ISO timestamp.

args.name: RunView
args.description: Run snapshot from ControlPlane.getRun: run metadata plus ordered event trace.

args.name: EventRow
args.description: A single trace event row: runId, seq, eventType (node_start/node_end/tool_call/checkpoint/hitl/run_started/run_completed/run_failed/run_cancelled), payload, createdAt.

args.name: StateStore
args.description: Persistence interface for agent-runtime: runs, node executions, checkpoints, tool calls, events, HITL interrupts. Implemented by SQLiteStateStore.

args.name: RunManager
args.summary: Run lifecycle manager: startRun/cancelRun/waitForRun/getRun/listRuns over in-memory scheduler + optional SQLite persistence; supports compile-time graph caching and HITL resume.
args.whenToUse: Need to start a compiled graph run, track run metadata/status, cancel long-running runs, or resume interrupted HITL runs inside the app process.
args.howToUse: Use defaultRunManager/startRun(graph, {input, runId?, store?, threadId?}) or getRun/cancelRun/waitForRun free functions exported from agent-runtime.

args.name: Scheduler
args.summary: Serial graph execution engine (runGraph): resolves node order via in-degree/adjacency, runs node executors with retry/backoff, collects channel state and node history, supports abort, checkpoints and ...
args.whenToUse: Need to execute a CompiledGraph node by node with retry policy, timeout, abort signal, or want to hook node start/complete/error/checkpoint events.
args.howToUse: runGraph(compiledGraph, input, abortSignal, {schedulerOptions}?) — returns SchedulerResult with status, channels, history and optional hitlInterrupt.

args.name: Channel/RunStatus/RunMetadata types
args.summary: Runtime state types (Channel, ChannelMap, RunStatus, RunMetadata, NodeExecutionRecord, ExecutionContext) plus channel helpers (createInitialChannels, mergeChannels, getChannel, serialize/deserializeCh...
args.whenToUse: Need to type or manipulate run state: read/write channels, construct run metadata, or serialize channels for persistence/checkpoints.
args.howToUse: Import types and helpers from agent-runtime; e.g. createInitialChannels(input) → ChannelMap, mergeChannels(channels, updates) then serializeChannels for storage.

args.name: NodeExecutors
args.summary: Built-in node executor set: Fn/Branch/LLM/Tool/HITL/Subgraph/Start/End executors implementing NodeExecutor, registered in BUILTIN_EXECUTORS via getExecutor(nodeType).
args.whenToUse: Need default behavior for a graph node type, or want to extend/replace an executor for fn/tool/branch nodes.
args.howToUse: getExecutor(nodeType) returns a NodeExecutor; pass custom executors map in SchedulerOptions.executors to override built-ins.

args.name: RunManager
args.summary: Run lifecycle manager: startRun/cancelRun/waitForRun/getRun/listRuns over in-memory scheduler + optional SQLite persistence; supports compile-time graph caching and HITL resume.
args.whenToUse: Need to start a compiled graph run, track run metadata/status, cancel long-running runs, or resume interrupted HITL runs inside the app process.
args.howToUse: Use defaultRunManager/startRun(graph, {input, runId?, store?, threadId?}) or getRun/cancelRun/waitForRun free functions exported from agent-runtime.

args.name: Scheduler
args.summary: Serial graph execution engine (runGraph): resolves node order via in-degree/adjacency, runs node executors with retry/backoff, collects channel state and node history, supports abort, checkpoints and ...
args.whenToUse: Need to execute a CompiledGraph node by node with retry policy, timeout, abort signal, or want to hook node start/complete/error/checkpoint events.
args.howToUse: runGraph(compiledGraph, input, abortSignal, {schedulerOptions}?) — returns SchedulerResult with status, channels, history and optional hitlInterrupt.

args.name: NodeExecutors
args.summary: Built-in node executor set: Fn/Branch/LLM/Tool/HITL/Subgraph/Start/End executors implementing NodeExecutor, registered in BUILTIN_EXECUTORS via getExecutor(nodeType).
args.whenToUse: Need default behavior for a graph node type, or want to extend/replace an executor for fn/tool/branch nodes.
args.howToUse: getExecutor(nodeType) returns a NodeExecutor; pass custom executors map in SchedulerOptions.executors to override built-ins.

args.name: CheckpointService
args.summary: Crash recovery: persists run checkpoints (channels + node history) per run/seq, exposes getLatest/getAll and resume() that rebuilds executing state into ResumeResult.
args.whenToUse: Need to make long graph runs crash-safe or restore a run after a process restart.
args.howToUse: new CheckpointService(store); write({runId, seq, nodeId, channels, metadata?}) then resume(runId, compiledGraph) to rebuild channels/history after a crash.

args.name: EventLog
args.summary: Sequenced event trace log persisted via StateStore: typed append helpers (node_start/node_end/tool_call/checkpoint/hitl/run_*), monotonic seq cache, getTrace for run inspection.
args.whenToUse: Need an append-only, ordered event stream per run for debugging, auditing, or feeding a UI timeline.
args.howToUse: new EventLog(store) or createEventLog(store); append* helpers write typed rows, getTrace(runId, fromSeq?) reads ordered trace for a run.

args.name: GraphCompiler
args.summary: Graph validation + compile pipeline: entry/terminal resolution, adjacency build, duplicate/dangling edge checks, auto graphId generation; outputs immutable CompiledGraph.
args.whenToUse: Before scheduling any run, to fail fast on malformed authoring-time graph definitions.
args.howToUse: compileGraph({graphId?, nodes, edges, entryNodeId?}) → CompiledGraph with adjacency/terminals; throws GraphCompileError on dangling edges, duplicate ids, missing terminals.

args.name: Graph types
args.summary: Graph authoring/compile type surface: NodeType, GraphNode/GraphEdge/GraphDefinition (authoring input), CompiledGraph (scheduler input), RetryPolicy.
args.whenToUse: Need the public graph model to author definitions or type a compiled run input.
args.howToUse: Import authoring types from agent-runtime to build GraphDefinition; pass to compileGraph. NODE_TYPES lists allowed node types.

args.name: HitlGateway
args.summary: Human-in-the-loop gateway: creates pending interrupts with unique tokens (status pending/resumed/expired/cancelled, expiry), stores decisions, resumes via HitlDecision.
args.whenToUse: Run needs human approval/decision mid-graph, with token-based resume and audit trail.
args.howToUse: createHitlGateway(store); intercept on a scheduler/run, then resume(token, decision) or getInterrupt(token) for audit; expires/cancels managed in store.

args.name: ToolRegistry
args.summary: Tool registry with JSON-schema definition + single handler type, list/get/lookup, and default-registry accessors.
args.whenToUse: Need to define tools an agent may call, and pass them to ToolRuntime or a tool node.
args.howToUse: new ToolRegistry(); register(name, schema, handler) then pass into ToolRuntime or use getDefaultRegistry/setDefaultRegistry singletons.

args.name: ToolRuntime
args.summary: Tool execution runtime: JSON-schema validation, timeout, retry/backoff, idempotency keys persisted via StateStore, and call observation/allowedtools filtering.
args.whenToUse: Need to call tools safely: validate inputs, enforce timeout/retry, dedup repeated calls, or record tool calls for replay.
args.howToUse: createToolRuntime(store?) or new ToolRuntime(registry, store?); call execute({tool, input, idempotencyKey?, timeoutMs?, ...}) with retry/idempotency support.

args.name: SQLiteStateStore
args.summary: SQLite-backed StateStore implementation: runs, node executions, checkpoints, tool calls, events, HITL interrupts over prepared statements; supports list/filter queries.
args.whenToUse: Need durable storage for agent runs/events/checkpoints, or to share one store across scheduler, HITL and tools.
args.howToUse: new SQLiteStateStore(dbPath or better-sqlite3 Database); then initialize() and pass to RunManager/CheckpointService/ToolRuntime/EventLog as the StateStore.

args.name: StateStore and Stored types
args.summary: Persistence contract: StateStore interface (graph/run/node/checkpoint/toolCall/event/hitl CRUD + list) with row shapes and runtime↔stored converters.
args.whenToUse: Need to swap/implement a state store, describe DB rows, or map runtime records into stored rows.
args.howToUse: Implement StateStore or consume via SQLiteStateStore; use Stored* records as the DB row shape; converters map runtime records to stored shapes.

args.name: SQLite migration runner
args.summary: Idempotent SQLite migration runner: creates the agent-runtime schema tables (graph, run, node execution, checkpoint, tool call, event, hitl interrupt).
args.whenToUse: Initializing a fresh SQLite DB before using SQLiteStateStore.
args.howToUse: runMigration(store) or runMigrationOnDb(db) applies the DDL idempotently (CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS); isMigrated() checks state.

args.name: ControlPlane
args.summary: In-process agent control API: compile/start/trace/list runs, resume/cancel HITL, tool registry access — the facade over RunManager+Store+EventLog.
args.whenToUse: Embedding agent-runtime in an app: one object to start runs, get RunView traces, resolve HITL, and list persisted runs.
args.howToUse: createControlPlane({runManager?, store?, tools?}) then compileGraph/startRun/getRun/listRuns/resumeHitl/cancelRun methods returning serializable DTOs (RunView etc).

args.name: HttpControlServer
args.summary: HTTP adapter for ControlPlane: JSON REST endpoints (compile/start/get/list/resume/cancel/trace) with an optional basePath, available as fetch handler or node http server.
args.whenToUse: Need remote/HTTP access to the agent control API, e.g. for dashboards or external callers.
args.howToUse: createFetchHandler(controlPlane, {basePath?}) returns a Request→Response handler for any fetch runtime; createHttpServer(...) wraps node http with listen/close.

args.name: OtelHooks
args.summary: OpenTelemetry integration points: optional hook registration bridging EventLog events into OTel spans, plus run-span helpers; no-ops cleanly when OTel is absent.
args.whenToUse: Want run/node/tool events to appear in an existing OTel pipeline without hard dependency.
args.howToUse: registerOtelHooks(eventLog) attaches OTel-instrumenting listeners to an EventLog (best-effort when @opentelemetry API present); isOtelAvailable(): boolean; createRunSpan/endRunSpan for manual spans.

args.name: agent-runtime index
args.summary: Public API barrel of agent-runtime (version constant, graph compiler/types, executors, scheduler, RunManager, checkpoint, HITL, tools, SQLite store, migration, events, OTel hooks, ControlPlane + HTTP ...
args.whenToUse: Find or use the whole agent-runtime SDK surface; typecheck examples against exactly the public exports.
args.howToUse: import from "agent-runtime" — this barrel is the single public surface; every runtime API listed here is exported from index.ts.

args.name: ToolExecutionResult
args.description: Output of a tool execution: toolName, input, output, status (completed/failed/timeout/cancelled/error), durationMs, attempt, idempotencyKey and error info.
